name: ebay-account
description: Connect Codex and ChatGPT to an eBay account through OAuth-backed MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Connect to an eBay account with OAuth-backed MCP tools.
interface.longDescription: Local scaffold for eBay account access from Codex and ChatGPT. The first version should expose read-only MCP tools for account profile, inventory, and orders, then add mutating listing tools behind explicit confirmation.
defaultPrompt: Show the connected eBay account profile.
